name: Vz Hextrudort Low Plus
description: The Vz Hextrudort Low Plus is the CNC variant of the Vz-HextrudORT with larger CNC gears compared to the standard Low version. Compatible with 8T or 10T NEMA14 round stepper motors. Designed for high-speed printers such as the VzBoT.

motorSpecs.compatibleMotors: NEMA14 round (8T or 10T pinion, e.g. LDO-36STH20-1004, Moons equivalent)

features: Larger CNC gears than standard Low version
Lightweight design for reduced toolhead inertia
Compatible with 8T or 10T NEMA14 round motors
Community design adapted from MirageC HextrudORT
